chapters.reason: The paper focuses on enabling additional reasoning capabilities in off-the-shelf decoder models through contemplation tokens, directly addressing multi-step reasoning performance.
The method involves generating contentful contemplation tokens as compressed representations of reasoning chains, which aligns with training strategies for CoT-aligned supervision and compression.
The approach utilizes intermediate representations (contemplation tokens) to distill essential reasoning information, functioning as a form of latent CoT within the model's processing flow.
